environmentRecovery: Sandboxed test workers hid individual results; normal isolated workers passed outside sandbox.
Sandboxed build worker output could not be parsed; clean unsandboxed build exited 0.
ESLint needed a longer bounded run on the mounted filesystem.
Chromium and missing runtime libraries were provisioned temporarily under /tmp without project dependency or system package changes.
A build that printed success but exited SIGTERM was rejected; the clean rerun exited 0.
Next dev generated AGENTS.md temporarily; it was removed after stopping dev, and next-env.d.ts matches baseline.
limitations: No deployment or live M3 production acceptance was performed.
Browser diagnostics use deterministic reports from the actual M2 engine, not live RPC.
Accessibility assertions cover labels, focus, announcements, reduced motion, target sizes and layout; no complete WCAG audit or human screen-reader/usability study.
The existing live qa:browser harness was updated for inline validation and linted, but was not run against production.
